title: Bill 145 property tax exemption for child care
summary: At the November 18, 2024 meeting, the chair asked commissioners to read about Bill 145 and discuss it at the next meeting. The bill would create a property tax exemption for child care providers. A speaker said committees have raised the proposed exemption from $100,000 to $200,000.
